description: Open-source WordPress plugin that adds e‑commerce capabilities and provides a REST API for managing products, orders, and customers.
access_requirements: Free core plugin; generate Consumer Key/Secret in WooCommerce admin
evidence_excerpts: "The WooCommerce REST API uses a key system to control access. Each set of keys is linked to a WordPress user on your site."
"Most integrations require you to generate API keys in WooCommerce and enter them in the external service to establish the connection."
"The WooCommerce REST API connects your store to external systems and services."
"WooCommerce REST API Docs — the complete technical reference for all available endpoints."
